bead.title: Normalize local utilization and performance probes
bead.description: Implement or correct local provider probes so vLLM, Rapid-MLX, oMLX, and llama-server feed normalized utilization/performance evidence into routing. Missing or stale provider metrics must fall back to service-owned lease counts instead of marking healthy endpoints unavailable.
bead.acceptance:
1. vLLM, Rapid-MLX, oMLX, and llama-server probes populate normalized EndpointUtilization when their server surfaces provide the data.
2. Active/queued counts, max concurrency, cache pressure when known, freshness, source, observed_at, and server_instance are normalized consistently.
3. Cassettes/goldens cover the parser behavior for each implemented local provider probe.
4. Failed/stale probes fall back to fizeau_leases with unknown provider utilization and keep otherwise healthy endpoints eligible.
5. go test ./internal/provider/... ./internal/routing/... -run "Utilization|VLLM|RapidMLX|OMLX|Llama|Routing" passes.
